title: Ad Astra Radio x Create: Crafts and Additions Compat
description: Datapack that changes Ad Astra's radio recipe to use items from Create and Create: Crafts and Additions
body:
Datapack that changes Ad Astra's radio recipe to use items from Create and Create: Crafts and Additions.

***Create: Crafts and Additions can be replaced with a mod that adds copper wire with the tag forge:wires/copper
